high_level_description: This image depicts a nighttime scene on a beach or a similarly reflective surface. The sky is dark, indicating it is either dusk or night, with no visible stars or moonlight. The horizon line is faintly visible, separating the dark sky from the darker water below. In the foreground, there are five glowing neon signs arranged horizontally. Each sign represents a ghost character from the classic video game "Pac-Man." The colors of the neon signs are yellow, white, pink, cyan, and red, corresponding to the five different ghost characters in the game.
